subject: Prod environment path qualification: hosted vs dedicated vs VPC — SOC2 / BAA evidence request
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@medisurehealth.com>, Michael Zhou <michael.zhou@medisurehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Prod environment path qualification: hosted vs dedicated vs VPC — SOC2 / BAA evidence request

Hi Emily / Michael,

Thanks again for the time this morning — appreciate the clarity on MediSure's regulatory posture. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before I loop in engineering/security for a short qualification sprint.

Recap (from our call):
- Primary use: inference-backed triage assistant processing PHI from EHR exports and clinician notes.
- Compliance drivers: HIPAA with a required BAA, SOC2 is required by procurement, and one audit per year.
- Preference: would like vendor to support private network connectivity or a VPC option; open to dedicated capacity if we can get stronger data isolation + HSM/KMS integration.
- Timeline: procurement expects a path and evidence packet within 2–3 weeks to put on their vendor shortlist.

What we can provide (next steps I suggest):
1) Redwood will share our latest SOC2 Type II report, network diagram, and a draft BAA for review. (I attached the SOC2 and diagram; BAA draft attached.)
2) Can you confirm whether MediSure requires: (a) dedicated on-tenant GPU pools, (b) private VPC peering (no public internet egress), or (c) on-prem installation? Those requirements determine what evidence we prioritize.
3) If you have a prioritized checklist from procurement/security we should align on, please share — we can map owners for each item.

If helpful, Laura (cc'd) is our Security & Compliance PM and can answer detailed SOC2 / logging / retention questions. Grace from Solutions can scope dedicated or VPC configurations once we know the desired target.

Would you be able to confirm item #2 today or tomorrow? That will let us get a targeted evidence packet to you within 48 hours.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2027.pdf (PDF, 12MB); Redwood_Network_Diagram_v2.png (PNG, 420KB); BAA_Draft_Redwood_MediSure.docx (DOCX, 85KB)

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@medisurehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Zhou <michael.zhou@medisurehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prod environment path qualification: hosted vs dedicated vs VPC — SOC2 / BAA evidence request

Thanks Rishi — solid recap. Quick answers from procurement/security side:

- Primary ask: BAA required. SOC2 Type II is preferred for vendor selection; please include the report and a short summary of scope (control categories).
- Connectivity: MEDISURE prefers Private VPC peering or an equivalent that prevents PHI egress to the public internet. Dedicated GPU pools would be acceptable if we can confirm network isolation and key management (customer-managed KMS/HSM).
- On-prem: only if neither VPC nor dedicated can meet our requirements — it's a last resort due to operational overhead.
- Audit evidence: procurement wants sample audit logs (retention policy), encryption-at-rest proof, and a diagram showing where PHI is stored/processed.

We'll review the attachments and aim to get back with a prioritized checklist by EOD tomorrow. In the meantime, please escalate the KMS/HSM capability and whether Redwood can support customer-managed keys or a bring-your-own-KMS model.

-Mary (oops — Emily)
Emily Carter
Director of Security & Compliance, MediSure Health
emily.carter@medisurehealth.com
